directions: incumbent iron plus/minus every recorded direction: DE3 member means, individual DE3 members, IBATCH members, and member differences

remaining_claimed_headroom.containment: The DE3 difference amplification line contains the incumbent at q=0.5 and is the same family as docs/iron_strength_correction/RESULTS.md, where q=1.0 measures worse on both complete splits.
remaining_claimed_headroom.unresolved: The A35-to-DE3 line at w=1 is the synthetic column 2*D_iron - A_iron: it extrapolates past the DE3 iron by the whole A35-to-V12 iron change, so no recorded model produces it and no recorded direction supports it.

limits: The directional test only covers recorded directions; it cannot rule out an unrecorded direction.
The A35 iron column is not re-measured here; the audit states containment and support, not a new bound.
No platform score is forecast and no history is rewritten.
